        ("conversation_teaching_states"."state" = 'restoring' AND "conversation_teaching_states"."learning_plan_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("conversation_teaching_states"."state" = 'unavailable' AND "conversation_teaching_states"."learning_plan_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_teaching_states"."mute_reason" IS NULL)

teaching_plan_generation_requests_runtim.name: teaching_plan_generation_requests_runtime_matches_source
teaching_plan_generation_requests_runtim.value:
(
        "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generator_source" = 'controlled_template'
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."model_profile_id" IS NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."model_profile_revision" IS NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."connection_revision" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generator_source" = 'text_model'
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."model_profile_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."model_profile_revision" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."model_profile_revision" > 0
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."connection_revision" IS NOT NULL
        AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."connection_revision" > 0
      )

teaching_plan_generation_requests_input_.name: teaching_plan_generation_requests_input_identity_matches
teaching_plan_generation_requests_input_.value: "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot" ? 'schemaVersion' AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot" ? 'generationMode' AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot" ? 'generatorSource' AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot" ? 'goalHash' AND NOT ("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot" ? 'learningGoal') AND jsonb_typeof("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->'schemaVersion') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->'generationMode') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->'generatorSource') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->'goalHash') = 'string' AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->>'schemaVersion' IN ('teaching-plan-generation-input-v2', 'teaching-plan-generation-input-v3') AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->>'generationMode' = "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generation_mode"::text AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->>'generatorSource' = "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generator_source"::text AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->>'goalHash' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."input_snapshot"->>'schemaVersion' <> 'teaching-plan-generation-input-v3' OR ("teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generation_mode" = 'text_model' AND "teaching_plan_generation_requests"."generator_source" = 'text_model'))
